notes: A pretty place whose only activity is dressing up together is Roleplay & Avatar Sim, and the author ruled out rounds and voting, so this is Morph Roleplay rather than Dress Up — there is no runway and no audience to build. settlement-static is the shape because its defining claim is exactly this prompt: a fixed pre-built space with no personal property, where personalization happens through the avatar; the genre warns against assuming plots or claimable houses, and nothing here asks for housing. The prompt is thin, so I decided the open parts myself: "server" is read as one pastel hangout area rather than a town of houses, and since nothing was said about going inside anything I added no interiors, which keeps this on a plain P0. vignette-photo carries most of the weight of "pretty aesthetic" — composed pastel spots to photograph outfits in — with the gathering area and a soft focal build around it.
